name: Yuanyou
summary: Yuanyou is HandX Innovation’s wheeled humanoid robot for everyday assistance and industrial support. It combines a mobile base, humanlike upper body, dexterous hands and multiple sensing modules. The manufacturer lists fine grasping, moxibustion-related actions and daily assistance among intended tasks. Product imagery and the corporate manual verify the named platform, while general availability and deployment scale remain unverified.
